{{Quote|We're not going anywhere. I swore an oath to keep the prisoners on Belsavis locked up. I'm not gonna leave and let this scum escape.|Kal|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Brok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] guard [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the security forces of [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], he became determined to ensure that a criminal named [[Gouge]] did not escape from the nearby labor camps, and three members of the disgraced [[Dagger Wing]]&mdash;[[Ty]], [[Symo]], and [[Lin (Dagger Wing)|Lin]]&mdash;volunteered to help him. The group found Gouge, but were pinned down until they were rescued by [[Havoc Squad]], which helped them evacuate the prisoner to a more secure location.

==Behind the scenes==
Brok appears in the Trooper class mission "Overwhelming Force" on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
